value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler. Partly sunny, high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below today's 80. Chance of rain is about 30% after 3 p.m., mostly in the evening. Tuesday night drops into the low 40s and some 30s, with a light north-northeast breeze of 6 to 10 mph.
